linkedin.article_body:
In early AI adoption, cloud APIs were necessary due to hardware constraints. In 2026, the paradigm has completely inverted.

Unified memory architectures (Apple Silicon M-series, AMD Strix Halo) and next-generation desktop GPUs have unlocked 85–145 tokens per second for frontier-class open models (Meta Llama 3.3 70B, Nous Hermes 3).

Why leading engineering teams are switching to Zoth Studio's local-first agent framework:

1. Deterministic Latency: Sub-50ms Time To First Token (TTFT) compared to 1,500ms+ cloud API latency under load.
2. Total IP Security: Proprietary source code never traverses public networks. Comply with strict GDPR, HIPAA, and defense-grade requirements effortlessly.
3. Zero API Downtime: Your agents keep building during cloud outages or Internet fiber cuts.
4. Rust Memory Daemon (:8485): Local vector embeddings and long-term memory indexed in RAM with zero telemetry.

Read our local silicon benchmark report: https://github.com/NullAITech/zoth-studio
